हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description: Indian Mythology With Devdutt Pattanaik is an enlightening talk show where renowned mythologist Devdutt Pattanaik breaks down India’s ancient stories, symbols, gods, and rituals with clarity and charm. Blending history, culture, and philosophy, he reveals how timeless myths shape the modern Indian mind and everyday life.
